title: test(schema-catalog): the gallery waits for a lazy tile to paint before reading its authored content
body:
Fixes #35407

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：组件目录画廊测试在检查看板和 Markdown 两类示例时，先确保它们延迟加载的真实内容已经出现，再判断内容是否上屏；断言本身一条未改、未放宽、未跳过。
- 为什么改：这个测试有时读到的是加载中的占位骨架而不是真实内容，于是时红时绿，把改到表格插件等相关包的 PR 从合并队列里踢出去（#35371 三次里红了两次）。
- 风险与回滚：只改一个测试文件，不动任何产品代码，用户无感；回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/examples/schema-catalog/test/catalog-gallery-render.test.tsx` 顶部新增的两行模块预加载，以及 `renderEntry` 开头新增的一次 `act` 让步。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run examples/schema-catalog/test/catalog-gallery-render.test.tsx -t "puts its authored content on screen"`，预期 19 个用例全绿（修复前稳定 5 个红）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One test file, `ui/examples/schema-catalog/test/catalog-gallery-render.test.tsx`; no product source.

1. **Module-scope loads of the two lazy implementation modules**, per the ui/AGENTS.md lazy-boundary rule: `../../../packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl` and `../../../packages/plugin-markdown/src/MarkdownImpl`, with a one-line comment.
2. **`await act(async () => {})` at the start of `renderEntry`**, before the existing settles.

Why both: `renderEntry`'s settle waits for `drewSomething`, and a Suspense Skeleton fallback (an element, no text) satisfies it. The preload alone was measured NOT to be enough: with it, the isolated run still failed 2 of 5 — the first-rendered kanban and markdown tile. `React.lazy` still suspends on its first render even when the module is loaded, because `import()` settles a tick later and the settle returns on the fallback before that tick. The `act` yield lets that tick reach the screen; it is only sufficient because the module is already loaded, which is what (1) guarantees. Both halves were ablated (below) and each is necessary.

**Same modules as the components' `import()`** — two proofs:

- Path: the vitest alias table maps `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` to `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src` and `@object-ui/plugin-markdown` to `ui/packages/plugin-markdown/src`. `KanbanBoardCore.tsx` there holds `React.lazy(() => import('./KanbanImpl'))`, and plugin-markdown's `index.tsx` holds `React.lazy(() => import('./MarkdownImpl'))`. Resolving the test's specifiers and the lazy targets gives the same realpath for each pair (`same= true` for kanban and markdown).
- Behaviour: removing only the preload turns the isolated run back to 5 failed. A preload of a different module instance could not have turned it green.

No changeset: `@object-ui/example-schema-catalog` is `private: true` and the diff is a test file, so nothing publishes (`skip-changeset`).

## Tests

No assertion added, removed or loosened. The pins are the existing `puts its authored content on screen` cases.

## Acceptance notes

- The order named route A (preload only). Preload alone was measured insufficient, so the fix adds the `act` yield inside the same file. Both halves are ablation-proven.

## Verification

<details><summary>Before / after — isolated run red 5 to green, whole file 579/579</summary>

- Before, at base `3f88af4c`: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 examples/schema-catalog/test/catalog-gallery-render.test.tsx -t "puts its authored content on screen"` gave `Tests 5 failed | 14 passed | 560 skipped (579)`. The 5 were kanban advanced-with-badges and basic-board, and markdown advanced-features, basic and tables.
- Preload only, at `56183817`: same command gave `Tests 2 failed | 17 passed | 560 skipped`, the first kanban and the first markdown tile.
- After, at `e605f090`: same command gave `Tests 19 passed | 560 skipped (579)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- After, whole file at `e605f090`: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 579 passed (579)`.
- After, whole package (`examples/schema-catalog/`): `Test Files 45 passed (45)`, `Tests 2438 passed (2438)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/example-schema-catalog run type-check` (`tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` included): exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation — each half removed alone turns the isolated run red</summary>

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; every leg was restored to the HEAD blob `a06cdce606ec` with `git diff HEAD` empty.

- Preload lines deleted: blob became `f2aada8cbe58` and the run gave `Tests 5 failed | 14 passed | 560 skipped`.
- `act` yield deleted: blob became `ca339620f405` and the run gave `Tests 2 failed | 17 passed | 560 skipped`.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates: 22 of 22 derived families exit 0 at e605f090</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 22 commands for 1 path, against merge base `3f88af4c9`. All 22 exited 0, with each exit code captured before any pipe. They include `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:type-check-coverage` and `check:type-check-debt`. The `--ran` reconciliation reads `22 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 22 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. Two more local checks: ui `check:new-line-citations` exited 0, and eslint on the changed file exited 0. CI owns Test UI and the type-check lanes.
</details>
